name: にちか
text:
電柱ごとに
死神みたいなのがいて
trans:
Behind the lamp posts, stands a figure
that looks like the grim reaper.

name: にちか
text:
捕まらないように
走り抜ける
trans:
I kept running ahead,
so that he won't catch me.

name: にちか
text:
────走り込みって
そういうものじゃないですー……？
trans:
—Aren't running laps just, 
supposed to be hard like that?

name: 整形外科医
trans: You're really going through it, aren't you...?

name: にちか
text:
えっ
そういう意味じゃ────
trans:
Huh?
No, that's not what I mea—

name: 整形外科医
trans: Okay, I'm done disinfecting your wound.

name: 整形外科医
text:
捻挫とかじゃなくてよかったと言うべきか
擦りむいちゃって不幸だったと言うべきか────
trans:
I'm not sure if I should say "good thing  it's
not a sprain" or "too bad you got grazed"...

name: にちか
text:
……
すみません。ありがとうございましたー……
trans:
...Sorry for the trouble.
Thank you for the treatment......

name: 整形外科医
text:
────
追いかけられるような走り方してるからだよ？
trans:
—Are you even aware that this happened 
because you ran to death like someone's
chasing you down?

name: 整形外科医
text: センセも朝夜走るヒトだけど────
trans:
You see, Doc goes out for a run in the
morning and evenings too, but—

name: 整形外科医
text: 楽しいよぉ、走るのはー
trans: Usually, running is fun, you know.

name: にちか
text: それはだって、趣味なら楽し──────
trans:
Well, that's a given if it's
actually your hobby—

name: 整形外科医
text: 走るメカニズムはあなたと同じです
trans: My motive for running is just the same as yours.

name: 整形外科医
text: ────メカニズムは何も変わらない
trans: —There's no difference between our motives at all.

name: 整形外科医
text: ボクが素人で、あなたが何でも
trans:
That applies whether I'm an amateur,
or you're whatever you may be.

name: 整形外科医
text: 走ることを不幸にしないで
trans: Don't turn running into a miserable activity.

name: にちか
text:
────けっこう日がのぼってきましたね……
まぶしい────
trans:
—The sun's quite high up now...!
It's so bright——!

name: にちか
text:
桜、いつのまにか
葉っぱだけになっちゃってるなーって思って……
trans:
Just noticed that the cherry blossoms fell off
in an instant, and now it's just all leaves....

name: にちか
text:
えっ
あ……ですですたぶん！
trans:
Huh? Ahh...
Yupyup, I think it is!

name: 整形外科医
text: 走ることを不幸にしないで
trans: Don't turn running into a miserable activity.

name: にちか
text: ちょっとなんか、気持ちよくて────
trans: Just thought that, this kinda felt nice—!

name: 美琴
trans:
...Let's go for another lap
after we finish drinking.
